orders.text:
WPSS No.3930/2018
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
 Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. Narain Dutt, Brief Holder for the 
State/respondent nos. 1 to 3. 
 Issue notice to the respondent no. 4. Steps to 
be taken within a week. 
 Counter affidavit be filed by the respondents 
within a period of three weeks. 
 List this case after four weeks in the daily 
cause list. 
 Until further orders of this Court, the 
respondents are restrained from initiating a fresh 
process for selection/appointment in the 
concerned College as evidently selection process 
has been stopped merely on the phone call of the 
Director (Secondary Education), Uttarakhand to 
the Chief Education Officer, Almora and no 
reasons have been assigned. 
 Interim relief application (CLMA 
No.18272/2018) stands disposed. 
 
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 
 29.11.2018 
 Ankit/

Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.

 Issue notice to the respondent no. 4. Steps to 
be taken within a week. 
 Counter affidavit be filed by the respondents 
within a period of three weeks.

cause list. 
 Until further orders of this Court, the 
respondents are restrained from initiating a fresh 
process for selection/appointment in the 
concerned College as evidently selection process

the Chief Education Officer, Almora and no 
reasons have been assigned. 
 Interim relief application (CLMA 
No.18272/2018) stands disposed. 
 
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 
 29.11.2018 
 Ankit/
